title: Surgical ops microactions and telemetry-led retry fabric
creator: Priya Kshatri
description: Build a lightweight library and runtime (steplet runtime) that exposes "microactions" — single-purpose, idempotent admin primitives — which can be executed as Linear tasks, invoked from the Console, or called by support automation playflows. Key differentiator: integration with telemetry-driven retry logic so we automatically apply conservative retries/backoff for flaky infra operations, and fail open to safe fallbacks. The runtime must be embeddable in existing admin UI and callable via the ops API with strict provenance headers and a replayable 'intent token' to guarantee idempotency and auditability.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Library provides a Steplet SDK (Go/TS) with contract for idempotent handlers and tokenized run metadata
A2: Runtime supports telemetry-led retry rules: rule engine accepts metrics (error type, latency, rate) and decides retry/backoff policy
A3: Steplets can be surfaced as Linear tasks with a single-click convert flow in Console and retain parameters in task body
A4: Every execution emits structured events (trace_id, steplet_id, intent_token) to existing telemetry pipeline and is searchable in Console
A5: Automated fallback rule can route to a safe read-only diagnostic step if primary action fails twice
A6: Demo run (internal) showing a db-index-recreate steplet being retried by telemetry rule and then failing over to readonly diagnostic, with audit log preserved
updates: 2026-03-10 - Ticket created; initial scoping meeting with Reliability and DX. Agreed on Go + TypeScript SDKs and a server-side controller for retries.
2026-03-12 - Design spike: prototype rule evaluation using existing telemetry dimensions (error_code, p95_latency, ephemeral_rate). Opted to keep rules declarative JSON stored in config service.
2026-03-13 - Infra note: decided against adding new queue service; reuse admin-runner queue (ENG-271444) to leverage existing backpressure and visibility.
2026-03-14 - Implemented idempotency token model: idempotency-key + intent_token pairing. Need to add deterministic replay guard in runtime to prevent duplicate side-effects.
2026-03-15 - PR opened for basic steplet handler spec (draft) and telemetry event schema. TODO: wire Console UI convert flow and create Linear->steplet mapping in backend.
risks: R1: Incorrect idempotency semantics could cause silent double-writes; mitigated by explicit intent_token and conservative default retries
R2: Over-eager retry rules might exacerbate outages; mitigate by circuit-breaker thresholds and dry-run telemetry analysis before rollout
R3: Auditing burden if events are too verbose; we will sample non-failure runs and index failures fully
notes: Implementation will reuse the admin-runner task queue and augment events with steplet metadata to avoid new infra services.
We will provide a catalog of ~12 curated microactions for first launch (db-diagnostic, index-rebuild, cache-warm, node-drain-safe), each with vetted safety profiles.
Owner rotation plan: pair SRE with a Support engineer for initial two-week rollout to validate telemetry rules in production as a controlled experiment.
